Position Title:

Business Development Manager - Sales (IT Infrastructure Solutions)

We are a skilled provider of infrastructure and IT solutions. Our specialists have total confidence in leading our clients as they are true professionals in their fields. We work with customers to implement the finest technology to solve their IT and business goals with a focus on achieving the outcomes customers want for their organization, their IT team, and their end-users. Our goal as a business is to learn from our clients, take the lead, and transform them towards excellence in their IT infra solutions and related services.

Job Overview:

We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Business Development Manager to drive new business growth and expand our client base for IT Infrastructure solutions and services. This is a leadership sales role requiring frequent field visits, senior-level client engagement, and a strong understanding of Networking, Servers, Data Centres, Cloud, and Managed Services. You'll be responsible for driving the end-to-end sales cycle - from lead generation and strategic account planning to closing high-value deals and mentoring the sales team.

Key Responsibilities:

Drive business development by identifying, pursuing, and closing new opportunities in IT infrastructure solutions

Generate and qualify leads through networking, cold calling, referrals, and market research

Understand customer requirements and present value-based, solution-oriented proposals

Build and manage relationships with key decision-makers in SMB and enterprise accounts

Own and achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets and revenue goals

Develop and execute strategic account plans to maximize revenue and client retention

Lead client meetings, pitches, and negotiations to closure

Maintain and update CRM with accurate pipeline and account data

Provide regular sales forecasts, reports, and business updates to leadership

Collaborate closely with technical and pre-sales teams to prepare proposals and solution designs

Track industry trends, competitor activity, and market opportunities in the IT services domain

Represent company at marketing campaigns, exhibitions, and product demos

Coordinate with internal teams (technical, finance, logistics) to ensure smooth client delivery

Mentor and guide junior sales executives as required

Ensure proper documentation of deals, proposals, and agreements

Qualification & Skillsets:

Science / Engineering (ECE, EEE, IT) degree required; MBA preferred

Strong working knowledge of IT infrastructure (LAN, Wi-Fi, Servers, Cloud, Data Centres, Managed Services)

Proven track record in B2B IT sales / business development

Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

Proficient in MS Word / Excel / PowerPoint

Confident, self-driven, target-oriented, and comfortable working with senior stakeholders

Willing to travel extensively; own vehicle mandatory

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About NationsBenefits:**

At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on platform modernization — transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core backoffice functions in the insurance domain.

**About Role:**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Product Manager** to own and drive the strategic direction of our Nations Vision product ecosystem — a multi-tool platform supporting hundreds of clients across the vision benefits landscape. The ideal candidate brings deep analytical rigor, unwavering attention to detail, and a relentless commitment to product quality and accuracy. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring someone who can navigate complex, interconnected systems — fee schedules, provider networks, plan configurations, and claims processing — while maintaining the trust of hundreds of clients who depend on flawless execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the end-to-end product roadmap for the Nations Vision platform, balancing client needs, business priorities, and technical constraints

* Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable product specifications.

**Core System Management:**

* **Provider-Facing Claims Portal:** Drive continuous enhancement of the provider portal, delivering new features that improve speed and accuracy for end users

* **Fee Schedule Design & Configuration:** Oversee the accuracy, configuration, and maintainability of fee schedules across the platform; champion self-service configuration tools that empower Operations teams

* **Provider Network Mapping:** Manage the configuration and integrity of provider network data, ensuring accurate mapping across geographies and specialties

* **Plan Access Restrictions:** Direct the setup and validation of plan-level access rules, benefit tiers, and eligibility parameters

* **Claims Processing Engine:** Partner with engineering to optimize claims adjudication logic, troubleshoot processing issues, and ensure accurate, timely claim outcomes.

**Quality & Accuracy Focus**

* Establish and monitor quality benchmarks across all product tools and workflows

* Proactively identify data integrity issues, configuration errors, and process gaps before they impact clients

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce errors, increase automation, and enhance system reliability

* Conduct regular audits and root-cause analyses, implementing preventive measures when issues arise.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the primary product liaison between engineering, operations, client services, and leadership

* Communicate product updates, risks, and roadmap changes clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

* Partner with client-facing teams to understand pain points and translate feedback into product enhancements

* Collaborate with QA to define testing protocols that ensure system accuracy at scale.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Support hundreds of client configurations, ensuring the platform scales without sacrificing accuracy.

* Address escalations related to fee schedules, network mapping, or claims discrepancies with urgency and precision.

* Gather and prioritize feedback from client-facing teams to inform the product backlog.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product management experience, preferably in healthcare, benefits administration, or insurance technology.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-component systems or platforms.

* Working knowledge of database systems, with ability to write moderately complex SQL queries.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data driven decisions.

* Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in high-stakes, accuracy-critical environments.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for varied audiences.

* Experience with claims processing systems, provider network data, or fee schedule management strongly preferred.

* Proven track record managing products that serve a large, diverse client base.

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field (MBA a plus).

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead a pioneering FinTech initiative with cutting-edge technologies and scalable architecture.

* Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing, innovative-driven environment.

* Impact the financial ecosystem by building secure, high-performance applications.

* Contribute to cutting-edge products that enhance member engagement in healthcare.

jobs.description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Digital Product Manager (AI)**
The Digital Product Manager at Amgen oversees the lifecycle of digital products, working closely with various teams to define the product vision, roadmap, and growth opportunities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Digital Product Manager, to join the AI & Data Innovation Lab Product Management Team. This role is focused on rapidly validating high-potential AI and data-driven business opportunities before major investment, helping Amgen determine which AI initiatives should be scaled, refined, paused, or redirected.
  
  
Operating at the intersection of business strategy, AI product innovation, data, technology, and enterprise transformation, this role will provide strategic product leadership across ambiguous, cross-functional opportunities and influence senior business and technology stakeholders on product direction, prioritization, investment, and scale.
  
  
This role requires a strong product mindset, sufficient technical depth to evaluate whether AI and data opportunities are practical, scalable, measurable, and aligned to Amgen’s enterprise technology direction. The successful candidate will understand how AI products are built, validated, deployed, monitored, and scaled in complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute rapid discovery sprints, prototypes, pilots, user research, and experiments to assess desirability, feasibility, viability, value, and risk. Use evidence to determine whether opportunities should advance, pivot, pause, or scale.
* Identify, frame, and validate AI-enabled business opportunities across Amgen. Translate broad transformation themes into clear problem statements, testable hypotheses, user needs, data requirements, success metrics, and validation plans.
* Assess how LLMs, AI agents, machine learning models, NLP, automation, knowledge retrieval, analytics, and intelligent workflow tools can improve productivity, decision quality, scientific discovery, operational efficiency, and workforce effectiveness.
* Evaluate whether proposed AI opportunities have the right data foundations, system integrations, architecture patterns, model capabilities, security controls, and operational support needed to move from concept to scalable solution.
* Partner with engineering, data science, and technical teams to align on scope, tradeoffs, and execution path.
* Conduct landscape assessments across different industries to learn how AI is leveraged to solve shared problem spaces at the macro level.
* Develop product requirements that account for user experience, data availability, model performance, output quality, explainability, reliability, latency, integration needs, governance, and ongoing measurement.
* Synthesize findings from validation work into clear product recommendations, opportunity briefs, technical feasibility assessments, business cases, and executive-ready narratives. Help leaders make informed decisions about where to invest, scale, or stop.
* Ensure validation efforts consider responsible AI, data privacy, model risk, cybersecurity, compliance, regulatory considerations, human oversight, change management, and enterprise scalability from the earliest stages of discovery.
* Facilitate workshops, discovery sessions, prioritization discussions, technical feasibility reviews, user experience design, process mapping, and decision forums. Communicate complex AI and data concepts in a clear, business-oriented way for senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 8-13 years of work experience in the related field
* Doctorate; or Master’s degree and 2 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* Associate’s degree and 8 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience; or
* High School Diploma or GED and 10 years of Information Systems, Technology, Product, Digital, AI, Data, Business Transformation, or related experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience with AI, machine learning, data products, automation, LLMs, agents, NLP, analytics, or enterprise AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of AI product development, including discovery, prototyping, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Familiarity with generative AI, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, prompt engineering, model orchestration, NLP, predictive analytics, or intelligent automation.

jobs.title: Product Manager (AI & Software Delivery)
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
At Techdome, we turn hard business problems into well-built software. Our engineers, designers, and domain specialists work side by side with clients across industries to ship products that set them apart, and AI is now part of almost everything we build.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We need a Product Manager who is as comfortable in an architecture review as in a client steering meeting. You will own projects from the first scoping conversation through to launch, keeping them on schedule, within budget, and tied to real business outcomes. You'll work with teams building traditional software as well as LLM-powered products, chatbots, AI agents, and automation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Shape the plan: Work with stakeholders to set scope, goals, timelines, milestones, and budgets that are technically realistic and aligned with business priorities.
* Keep teams moving together: Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysis so handoffs are clean and nobody is blocked.
* Deliver AI/ML projects: Guide LLM integrations, chatbots, AI agents, and automation initiatives from idea to production, partnering closely with engineers, data scientists, and ML specialists.
* Learn each client's world fast: Absorb a client's industry and turn its domain rules and compliance needs into clear, buildable requirements.
* Manage people and partners: Allocate internal resources, and handle third-party vendors, including contracts, expectations, and performance.
* Control change and risk: Run disciplined change control over scope, schedule, and cost, and spot technical, delivery, and AI-specific risks early enough to act on them.
* Report with clarity: Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give management and clients honest, regular status updates.
* Be a trusted partner to clients: Build lasting relationships through open, proactive communication.
* Document and automate: Keep project records complete and easy to find, and use AI tools to speed up planning and reporting.

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years as a Product Manager on software or technology projects, with a track record of delivering complex work on time and on budget.
* Solid experience leading cross-functional teams (design, development, QA, DevOps) and a real understanding of how each function operates.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, plus tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Strong technical grounding in the SDLC, system architecture (APIs, microservices, databases), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD, enough to join technical debates and challenge estimates with confidence.
* Hands-on exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI projects, including the AI lifecycle (data, model evaluation, deployment, monitoring) and its risks: privacy, bias, hallucinations, and cost.
* Experience in more than one domain, such as FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, or SaaS, and the ability to pick up new domains and their compliance standards quickly.
* Strong risk management, change management, vendor management, and stakeholder communication skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI or cloud credential.
* Deep expertise in at least one industry domain.

**Why Techdome?**

* Own AI-driven, technically demanding projects across a variety of industries.
* Work with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts, with real say in how your projects are run.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
**end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains**
. This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
  
  
The Lead Product Owner acts as the
**central accountability point across a portfolio of related products**
, coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
  
  
This role is critical to enabling
**product‑led execution at scale**
within the CDO.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**

* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:

+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.

**Leadership & Coaching**

* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Business Partnership**

* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.

**Roadmap, Backlog & Delivery Governance**

* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:

+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.

**Quality, Governance & Trust**

* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:

+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.

**Value Realization & Continuous Improvement**

* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:

+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.

**Preferred**

* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.

**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**

* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.

**Why This Role Matters**
The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
**scale product‑led execution without chaos**
, reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

**Job Objective**

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Product Manager for our Cardio-Diabetes division who can develop strong brand strategies, scientific promotional inputs, field-force training modules, and marketing campaigns to drive prescriptions and brand growth.The candidate should have a strong understanding of diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, neuropathy, and related chronic therapy markets.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

1**. Brand Strategy & Planning**  
• Develop brand plans for Cardio-Diabetes products including anti-diabetic, lipid-lowering, antihypertensive, and neuropathy products.  
• Create positioning, communication strategy, and promotional campaigns for each brand.  
• Identify market opportunities, therapy gaps, and competitor strategies.  
• Plan monthly and quarterly marketing activities to support sales growth.

  

**2. Promotional Inputs & Scientific Content**

* Prepare visual aids, LBLs, reminder cards, leave-behind literature, product monographs, and doctor engagement material.  
  • Develop evidence-based scientific communication for CPs, Diabetologists, Endocrinologists, and Cardiologists.  
  • Ensure all promotional inputs are medically accurate, compliant, and easy for the field team to communicate.

  

**3. Field Force Training**

* Train MRs and Area Managers on product knowledge, therapy knowledge, objection handling, and doctor-wise detailing.  
  • Prepare product training modules, FAQs, competitor comparison charts, and detailing scripts.  
  • Conduct regular review and refresher training sessions.

  

**4. Market & Competitor Analysis**

* Track leading brands, pricing, pack styles, doctor preferences, schemes, and prescription trends.  
  • Analyze fast-moving SKUs in diabetes, lipid, hypertension, and neuropathy segments.  
  • Provide insights to management for new product selection and portfolio expansion.  
  5. Doctor Engagement & KOL Development  
  • Help identify key doctors, opinion leaders, and high-potential prescribers.  
  • Plan CME activities, small group meetings, doctor campaigns, and prescription generation initiatives.  
  • Support field team in converting important doctors through scientific and brand-led communication.

  

**6. Sales Support & Coordination**

* Work closely with the sales team to improve prescription productivity.  
  • Create area-wise and doctor-wise promotional strategies.  
  • Monitor brand performance and suggest corrective actions where required.  
  • Coordinate with design, printing, manufacturing, and management teams for timely execution of marketing inputs.

  

**Product Exposure Preferred**

  

**Candidate should have experience or strong knowledge in the following therapy areas**:

* Glimepiride + Metformin combinations  
  • Dapagliflozin / SGLT2 inhibitors
* Rosuvastatin and Rosuvastatin combinations  
  • Ezetimibe combinations  
  • Fenofibrate combinations  
  • Telmisartan / Olmesartan combinations  
  • Pregabalin and diabetic neuropathy products  
  • Methylcobalamin, Alpha Lipoic Acid, Benfotiamine-based neuropathy products

**Required Skills**

  

* Strong product management and brand-building skills.  
  • Good understanding of Cardio-Diabetes therapy.  
  • Ability to create scientific yet practical doctor communication.  
  • Strong presentation and training skills.  
  • Good command over English, Hindi, and preferably Gujarati.  
  • Ability to work with sales teams and convert strategy into execution.  
  • Knowledge of Indian pharma market, doctor behavior, and chronic prescription trends.  
  • Creative mindset for brand campaigns and promotional inputs.

  

**Qualification**

  

* B.Pharm / M.Pharm / MBA in Marketing preferred.  
  • Science or pharmacy background will be an advantage.

  

**Experience**

  

* Minimum 3-7 years of experience in pharma product management.  
  • Experience in Cardio-Diabetes, chronic therapy, or physician-focused divisions preferred.  
  • Candidates with strong field experience in Cardio-Diabetes and product management exposure may also be considered.

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

  

The ideal candidate should be energetic, scientific, field-oriented, and capable of building a new division from the ground level. He or sheshould understand both doctor psychology and field-force execution, with the ability to create brands that are clinically strong and commercially successful.

  

**Compensation**

Salary will be based on experience, capability, and industry standards.

Job Description

Senior Manager Manufacturing Operations (IVD Products)

**Experience:** 4-7 Years  
**Function:** Manufacturing Operations  
**Level:** Leadership Team  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Mobilab, Noida Sec 6.

  

About the Role

Mobilab is looking for a **Senior Manager Manufacturing Operations** to take end-to-end ownership of manufacturing operations across our IVD product portfolio, including **Biochemistry Devices, Urine Analyzers, FIA Analyzers, and Reagents**.

  

This is a senior, hands-on leadership role responsible for ensuring **production discipline, cross-functional coordination, quality compliance, timely batch completion, and continuous improvement** across the manufacturing function.

  

The role will work closely with **Procurement, QC, Inventory, Production, Dispatch, R&D, and other relevant functions**, bringing these teams together as one accountable manufacturing unit.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working on the shop floor, identifying problems proactively, conducting root-cause analysis, and driving corrective and preventive actions through to closure rather than simply escalating issues.

  

Key Responsibilities

1. End-to-End Manufacturing Operations

* Own end-to-end coordination of manufacturing activities from **material readiness and procurement to production, testing, QC, packaging, and dispatch**.
* Ensure timely execution and completion of production batches across all product lines.
* Coordinate closely with **Procurement, Production, QC, Inventory, and Dispatch** to ensure smooth batch execution.
* Monitor production plans against material availability, manpower, equipment readiness, and inventory status.
* Identify potential bottlenecks and risks proactively and implement corrective actions before they impact production.

2. Shop-Floor Management & Production Discipline

* Drive daily and weekly shop-floor discipline, productivity, SOP adherence, and production output.
* Conduct regular shop-floor reviews and personally monitor:

+ Assembly activities
+ Testing and calibration
+ Yield and rejection rates
+ Rework and repair
+ Process adherence
+ Packaging and final inspection

* Ensure production blockers are identified and addressed on the same day wherever possible.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager, Platform

Noida Reports to SVP Product 7–10 years

Your customers are mostly inside the building. Discovery, growth, content, partnerships

and finance all build on the systems you own, and none of them should have to think

about how those systems work. You'll turn a set of services that grew up separately into

one platform with clear contracts, owners and SLAs.

Growth PMs decide who subscribes and why. You make sure that once someone pays,

that fact is true everywhere, instantly, on every device and every partner app. You don't

own a conversion funnel; you own the rails the funnel runs on.

**What you'll own**

1. Entitlements and rights. One resolution layer that answers "can this user watch this, here, now" across plan types, partner services, linear TV and DTH, exposed as a serviceevery team calls
2. Billing infrastructure. Payment orchestration and gateway routing, UPI autopay and mandates, reconciliation, and partner revenue-share settlement that finance can close the books on
3. Partner integration framework. A standard way to plug in a new OTT service: catalogue ingestion, SSO and deep links, entitlement callbacks, usage reporting. Success is weeks to onboard, not quarters
4. Identity and devices. Login, OTP, profiles and device management across phone, web and TV
5. Content and config backbone. The metadata pipeline, CMS and remote-config layer that discovery and editorial teams build their surfaces on
6. Platform health. Service SLAs, observability, and a single event and data layer the whole company trusts...

**How you'll be measured**

Entitlement accuracy, payment-rail uptime and reconciliation gaps, API latency, time to

onboard a partner, and how often other teams are blocked waiting on platform.

You'll likely have

Built platform, billing, identity or integration products at a consumer company at scale; streaming, telecom or fintech backgrounds fit well

The technical depth to shape service boundaries, API contracts and data models with architects, not just review them

Taken a messy set of legacy systems to a single source of truth without stopping the

business

Written specs that other PMs and engineering teams build against

**It'll suit you if**  you'd rather design a clean contract between two systems than a launch

campaign, and you judge your work by how rarely anyone has to talk about it.

We are a collaborative, customer-focused team that values continuous learning and operational excellence. jobs.description:
Corporate Credit Analyst

Department: Risk Management / Corporate Credit Risk

Location: Hyderabad

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 3–7 Years

About the Company

Venus FinTech is a growing FinTech company providing technology-driven financial solutions to businesses and corporates. The company offers a range of corporate lending and financial products designed to support business growth, working capital requirements, expansion, and other financial needs.

Job Responsibilities

Corporate Financial Analysis:

Analyse corporate balance sheets, profit & loss statements, cash flow statements, financial ratios, annual reports, and projected financial statements to assess the financial strength and repayment capacity of borrowers.

Corporate Credit Assessment:

Evaluate credit proposals for various corporate lending products, including working capital facilities, term loans, business loans, project finance, secured lending, and other corporate credit facilities.

Credit Risk Evaluation:

Assess the borrower's credit history, financial performance, debt obligations, repayment capacity, business model, management quality, industry outlook, and overall creditworthiness.

Working Capital Assessment:

Analyse working capital requirements, operating cycles, inventory, receivables, payables, banking transactions, and fund utilisation to determine appropriate credit limits.

Cash Flow & Debt Servicing Analysis:

Evaluate projected cash flows, DSCR, interest coverage, leverage, repayment schedules, and other financial indicators to determine the borrower's ability to service debt.

Collateral & Security Evaluation:

Review the quality and adequacy of collateral, securities, guarantees, and other risk-mitigation measures associated with the proposed credit facility.

Credit Appraisal & Recommendations:

Prepare detailed credit appraisal notes, credit assessment reports, and summary memos with clear recommendations for approval committees and senior management.

Financial Modelling:

Prepare and review financial models, projections, sensitivity analysis, and stress scenarios to assess the potential impact of changes in revenue, margins, interest rates, working capital, and other business conditions.

Industry & Business Analysis:

Evaluate the borrower's industry, market position, competitive environment, business risks, customer concentration, supplier dependency, and other external factors that may affect repayment capacity.

Portfolio Monitoring:

Monitor existing corporate loan accounts, repayment behaviour, financial performance, covenant compliance, credit exposure, asset quality, and early warning signals.

Risk Identification & Mitigation:

Identify potential credit risks and recommend appropriate risk-mitigation measures, including suitable security, covenants, guarantees, limits, repayment structures, and monitoring requirements.

Regulatory & Policy Compliance:

Ensure credit assessments and lending decisions are aligned with the company's internal credit policies, risk framework, lending guidelines, and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.

Coordination:

Coordinate with Sales, Relationship Managers, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Collections, and other relevant teams to ensure efficient processing and monitoring of corporate credit facilities.

Skills Required

- Strong knowledge of corporate credit analysis and lending processes.

- Strong financial statement analysis and interpretation skills.

- Good understanding of corporate loans, working capital facilities, term loans, and other business lending products.

- Ability to analyse cash flows and assess debt-servicing capacity.

- Strong knowledge of financial ratios, including DSCR, Debt/Equity, Interest Coverage Ratio, Current Ratio, and other credit metrics.

- Good understanding of collateral, securities, guarantees, and credit risk mitigation.

- Strong MS Excel and financial modelling skills.

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to identify financial and business risks.

- Good communication and report-writing skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

- Strong decision-making and risk-assessment skills.

Key Performance Areas (KPIs)

- Accuracy and quality of corporate credit assessments.

- Timely completion of credit appraisal and recommendations.

- Quality of financial analysis and risk identification.

- Accuracy of financial models and credit reports.

- Effective identification and mitigation of credit risks.

- Portfolio quality and monitoring of existing corporate accounts.

- Compliance with internal credit policies and regulatory requirements.

- Timely identification of early warning signals.

- Accuracy and completeness of credit documentation.

- Turnaround time for credit assessment and decision-making.

Interested Candidates

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with the HR team.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager - myRico
jobs.description:
Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

**Mission**

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.

**The role**

We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.

You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.

This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.

**What we’re looking for**

* **Customer obsession.** You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.
* **Product judgment.** You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.
* **A builder’s instinct.** You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.
* **Technical fluency.** You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.
* **Care for the details.** You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.
* **Ownership.** You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.
* **Clear communication.** You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.

**Experience**

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.

Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

This role will be a poor fit if

* You need a fully defined roadmap before you can make progress.
* You prefer handing off requirements to staying involved through implementation and adoption.
* You’re uncomfortable spending substantial time with customers or examining where the product fails.
* You find it difficult to change direction when the evidence challenges your original idea.

Bonus

* You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.
* You’ve worked on collaboration tools, developer products or complex business workflows.
* You’ve been a founder or an early employee at a startup.
* You can build working prototypes yourself.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in product management or related technical role.
* 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience driving product direction, go-to-market strategy, and design with data-driven decisions.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in a technology or business related field.
* Experience launching successful app products in the market.
* Experience with complex product/outbound customer work, and developing products with an understanding of current cloud technologies and services.
* Knowledge of market, landscape, and customer/user requirements in-depth.
* Ability to collaborate, solve ambiguous problems, and think innovatively.
* Excellent communication, technical, and organizational skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

The mission of the Google Workspace team is to deliver flexible, innovative solutions for people and organizations to achieve more. As a Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and set product priorities. You will partner closely with Engineering and cross-functional teams to define and deliver on cloud services.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define the product direction and strategy for product areas within Google Workspace.
* Design and lead the product roadmap by managing goals and investments to scale globally.
* Engage with customers to understand their strategies, end-to-end business processes, pain points, and priorities to inform product strategy and provide transparency into roadmaps/managing expectations.
* Partner closely with Engineering, UX, and other internal Google teams to drive product and delivery success. Analyze landscape and industry trends to advance our products and drive innovation.
* Foster and facilitate timely decision-making across a broad network of stakeholders, delivery partners, and operational teams. Attract, develop, and retain an excellent team of product managers.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

Product Line Manager

The Product Specialist serves as the operational backbone of the Process Performance Motor portfolio, responsible for maintaining product data quality, supporting lifecycle projects, coordinating cross-functional activities, and providing market and competitive intelligence. This role translates customer and market needs into actionable insights, ensuring that Product Management and R&D decisions are grounded in accurate data and real customer requirements.

jobs.title: Lead UA Manager
jobs.description:
**Level Up Your Career!**

At Kwalee, you’ll join a gaming powerhouse that boasts a mobile empire with 1.5 billion+ downloads alongside a thriving PC & Console division that has achieved numerous global chart-topping releases across Steam, Consoles, and Amazon, driving millions of Wishlists. Most recently publishing breakout hits such as The Precinct and Town to City. It’s a unique chance to bring your expertise to a global studio that dominates both the mobile, and the indie PC and Console space.

At Kwalee, as well as a competitive salary we also offer; Private Medical Insurance, door-to-door transport scheme, free food & drinks, free game codes & merch, LinkedIn Learning, 20 annual leave days + bank holidays, and 1 day extra day for each year of service capped at 5.

Kwalee’s Product & Growth team is looking for a Lead User Acquisition Manager to steer User Acquisition across our mobile portfolio: live hits, much-loved classics, and exciting new games looking for their big break.

We’ll shape the title around your experience, from Senior UA Manager to Lead UA Manager or even Head of UA, because it’s the impact that matters.

This role is for you if you’re a hands-on UA leader who gets a real buzz from spotting where the next profitable pound of spend is hiding, and proving it. You’ll grow a team of UA Managers who proudly own their games and bring an investor’s eye to the whole portfolio, so every game and every campaign earns its place in the spotlight.

This role is based in our Bangalore studio, with onsite work 5 days per week, where daily in-office collaboration fuels creativity and innovation.

### **What You’ll Do:**

* **Steer portfolio UA.** Set the UA strategy across our games and channels, and put every pound where it works hardest.
* **Grow a brilliant team.** Lead and coach our UA Managers, give each of them clear ownership of their games, and help them do the best work of their careers.
* **Unlock profitable scale.** Find the games ready to grow faster, and move quickly when something isn’t paying back.
* **Keep targets sharp.** Work with our analytics team on LTV and ROAS targets, and bring a healthy challenge when the numbers don’t add up.
* **Power the creative engine.** Partner with our creative and analytics teams so every game has a steady flow of fresh ads being tested, learned from, and scaled.
* **Give new games a fair shot.** Run clean, consistent market tests for our new game ideas so we can spot the winners early.
* **Be the UA voice in our game teams.** Share what the market is telling us with producers, product, and monetisation, and turn game improvements into more growth.
* **Build great partnerships.** Work closely with ad networks and platforms, and keep exploring new channels

### **What You’ll Own:**

**Profitable growth across our portfolio.** You’ll be the go-to owner of how our games grow: spotting opportunities first, catching dips early, keeping targets sharp, and helping your team stay on top of every game they own.

**How we’ll celebrate your success:**

* Profitable spend and installs at or above target payback
* ROAS and payback against target
* UA contribution to profit across the portfolio
* How quickly budget moves to the best opportunities
* A happy, growing UA team

### **What We’re Looking For:**

**Essential**

* Senior UA experience in mobile games, with F2P titles you’ve scaled profitably across ad networks and social channels.
* Experience leading or mentoring UA Managers.
* A strong grasp of ROAS, payback, LTV and cohort analysis, and of measurement in today’s privacy- first world.
* A love of creative testing, and a feel for what makes an ad win on different channels.
* Great commercial judgement: you can explain every budget decision in pounds.
* Happy to get hands-on with campaigns, spreadsheets, and BI tools.
* A clear, confident communicator who brings people along with evidence.

**Desirable**

* Hybrid-casual or puzzle mobile game experience is a big plus.

### **Why Kwalee?**

* **Generous Holiday:** Start with 20 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays. You'll also earn an extra day for every year of service, up to 5 years!
* **Flexible Working:** We offer core hours that allow you to work flexibly around your life, and a bank of 'Work From Home' days to use when you need them.
* **Health Cover:** Private Medical Insurance covering you and your family
* **Free Food & Drink:** Fuel your day with unlimited free snacks and drinks.
* **Gaming Goodies:** Receive Steam codes for all our game releases!
* **Transport:** Save on your commute with our budget-friendly, door-to-door transport facility.
* **Office Location:** Work from our Bangalore office immersing yourself in the dynamic heart of India's Silicon Valley, where explosive career opportunities seamlessly blend with a vibrant, cosmopolitan lifestyle and fantastic year-round weather.
* **Professional Development:** Take advantage of our corporate LinkedIn Learning subscription to enhance your skill set
* **Merch & Events:** Get exclusive Kwalee merch, enjoy fun seasonal events, and stay informed with regular town halls.

### **Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kwalee, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer, where we believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to driving creativity. We are committed to creating a safe, welcoming, and supportive environment where everyone can thrive.

Our culture is built on celebrating the diverse voices of our team members, fuelling innovation and strengthening our connection to our players. We are dedicated to advancing equity, diversity, and inclusion across all areas of life, including age, disability, gender identity, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation.

We recognise the importance of self-development, career progression, and well-being in retaining our talented team. At Kwalee, we celebrate individuality and encourage everyone…

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Scapia! A credit card that’s out there to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We’re a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don’t stop until we’re proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else! We’ve worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own and scale our Airport Privileges & Lounge experience end-to-end.

This is a high-ownership role where you’ll work across product, engineering, operations, partnerships and external ecosystem partners to build a seamless airport experience for Scapia customers. You’ll own the customer journey from discovering their airport benefits to accessing lounges and resolving issues when things don’t go as planned.

**What You’ll Own**

* Own the product roadmap for airport privileges, lounges and related airport experiences.
* Build a simple, intuitive customer experience across discovery, eligibility, access, usage and post-visit journeys.
* Work closely with lounge operators, airport partners, networks and banking partners to improve coverage, reliability and customer experience.
* Identify operational gaps and build scalable product + process solutions rather than relying on manual intervention.
* Define and track key metrics around lounge usage, eligibility, successful access, customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
* Work closely with engineering and design to translate customer and business problems into high-quality product experiences.
* Use customer insights, data and operational feedback to continuously improve the product.
* Navigate complex edge cases across eligibility, spend criteria, guest access, lounge availability, transactions and partner systems.
* Drive cross-functional execution and ensure initiatives move from idea → launch → measurable impact.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–7 years of product management experience, preferably in fintech, travel, payments, consumer internet or other high-scale consumer products.
* Strong product sense with the ability to simplify complex customer journeys.
* Experience working with multiple external/internal stakeholders and partner ecosystems.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort using data to identify problems and measure impact.
* High ownership and bias for action — you should be comfortable operating in ambiguity and building from scratch.
* Strong understanding of operational processes and the ability to convert recurring operational problems into scalable product solutions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A genuine interest in travel and building experiences that customers love.

**What makes this role interesting**

Airport experiences sit at the intersection of travel, fintech, payments, partnerships and operations. You’ll have the opportunity to own a high-visibility product area end-to-end and solve problems that directly impact customers at one of the most important moments in their travel journey.

**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**Product Strategy & Vision**
**In this role, your work will involve:**

* Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap based on market trends, customer needs, and company goals.
* Work closely with senior management and stakeholders to align the product strategy with business objectives.

**Market & User Research**

* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify opportunities, gaps, and market demands.
* Understand customer needs and translate them into product requirements.
* Define user personas and use cases to ensure products meet user expectations.

**Product Development**

* Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to deliver products that are functional, user-friendly, and aligned with business goals.
* Prioritize product features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on customer feedback, technical feasibility, and business impact.
* Manage the product development lifecycle, including setting timelines and milestones.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with cross-functional teams (sales, marketing, customer support) to ensure successful product launches.
* Communicate progress, roadblocks, and product updates with stakeholders and teams across the organization.
* Lead and facilitate communication between technical and non-technical teams.

**Performance Tracking & Iteration**

* Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for product success.
* Track product performance post-launch and gather customer feedback for continuous improvement.
* Iterate on product features based on data insights and feedback.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Present product updates, roadmaps, and strategies to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Manage relationships with external vendors and partners as needed.

**Go-to-Market Strategy**

* Collaborate with the marketing and sales teams to define go-to-market strategies for product launches.
* Ensure proper communication and training for internal teams and customers during product releases.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
* 5+ years of experience in product management, preferably in the tech or software industry.
* Strong understanding of product development processes, including agile methodologies.
* Ability to work with cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with tools like JIRA, Asana, or other project management platforms.
* Knowledge of user experience (UX) design principles.
* Experience working with APIs and technical teams.
* Data-driven mindset with experience in A/B testing and user research methodologies.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

jobs.title: Manager, Product
jobs.description:
**Company Introduction**
Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
  
  
Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity, so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
  
  
**About Availity India**
Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India team’s partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
  
  
Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**About The Role**
Availity is seeking a strategic and customer-focused
**Product Manager**
to drive the vision, strategy, and execution of the
**Availity Essentials Portal**
, the industry's leading multi-payer provider portal.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with providers, healthcare organizations, engineering, UX, data, and business stakeholders to identify provider pain points, uncover new opportunities, and deliver innovative solutions that simplify healthcare administration and improve provider-payer interactions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for the Availity Essentials Portal, ensuring alignment with customer needs, business goals, and provider engagement objectives.
* Conduct customer discovery with providers and healthcare stakeholders to identify workflow challenges, validate opportunities, and deliver impactful solutions.
* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, including requirements gathering, prioritization, development, launch, measurement, and continuous optimization.
* Partner closely with Engineering, UX, Data, and business teams to build intuitive, scalable, and user-centric experiences that improve provider efficiency.
* Leverage data, analytics, and AI-powered tools to drive product decisions, accelerate innovation, measure outcomes, and continuously improve adoption and customer satisfaction.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related product leadership roles, preferably within healthcare technology environments.
* Hands-on experience with provider portals, revenue cycle management workflows, payer-provider interactions, and healthcare administrative processes.
* Proven track record of leading products through discovery, roadmap development, delivery, launch, and ongoing optimization.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development practices and experience collaborating with Engineering, UX, Analytics, and cross-functional business teams.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and prioritization skills with the ability to make data-driven decisions based on customer value and business impact.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building or managing provider-facing healthcare applications, multi-payer portals, or provider engagement platforms.

*Computer*

When you are not working on-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
  
  
**Position Details**
**About The Role**

* Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for global payments, subscription billing and auto-renewal experiences.
* Drive payment orchestration initiatives, PSP integrations, and expansion of global and local payment methods to improve conversion and payment success rates.
* Define product requirements and lead delivery across payments, billing, fraud prevention, disputes and card lifecycle management.
* Partner with engineering, finance, operations, risk, and external payment providers to deliver scalable, compliant and customer-centric solutions.
* Leverage data, experimentation, and industry insights to optimize authorization rates, reduce involuntary churn, and drive revenue growth.

**About You**

* 7–10 years of Product Management experience, with a strong background in payments, fintech, eCommerce or financial services.
* Deep expertise in subscription businesses, recurring billing, auto-renewals, payment lifecycle management, and revenue optimization.
* Strong understanding of payment orchestration, PSPs, gateways, tokenization, fraud prevention and chargeback management.
* Proven experience launching and scaling global payment methods while balancing customer experience, conversion and compliance.
* Data-driven and analytical, with strong experience in KPIs, funnel analysis, A/B testing, and payment optimization, coupled with a proven track record of delivering measurable business impact through cross-functional leadership.

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a

jobs.title: AI Security & Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Metaforms**
-------------------

Metaforms builds AI infrastructure for research delivery teams. Our agents help market research agencies and sample providers execute complex workflows with greater speed, consistency, and scale.

As these agents interact with customer data, files, APIs, integrations, and other tools, security must be built into every layer of the platform. We are looking for an engineer who is excited about understanding how AI systems can fail—and building the controls that make them safe, reliable, and secure by default.

**About the role**
------------------

We’re looking for an **AI Security & Platform Engineer** to help secure the AI agents and infrastructure behind Metaforms.

You will test our AI systems adversarially, identify vulnerabilities across prompts, context, data, tools, integrations, and execution environments, and work with engineers to fix them properly. You will also build platform-level controls, automated evaluations, monitoring, and secure infrastructure that prevent similar vulnerabilities from recurring.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a policy or compliance position. You will write code, inspect production systems, reproduce vulnerabilities, build security tooling, and contribute directly to product and infrastructure improvements.

You will work closely with engineering leadership and gradually take ownership of larger AI security and platform initiatives.

**What you’ll work on**
-----------------------

### **AI and agent security**

* Adversarially test AI agents for prompt injection, context poisoning, unsafe tool use, data leakage, memory manipulation, and unintended behavior.
* Identify security risks introduced through customer prompts, uploaded files, retrieved content, external links, integrations, and model-generated outputs.
* Test whether agents can access unauthorized tools, records, tenants, credentials, or internal services.
* Threat-model new AI features, agent workflows, model integrations, and tool-calling capabilities before they reach production.
* Evaluate risks in RAG pipelines, context assembly, agent memory, system prompts, MCP servers, model providers, and third-party AI frameworks.
* Build repeatable adversarial evaluations and regression tests for discovered vulnerabilities.
* Design controls for least-privilege tool access, scoped credentials, sandboxing, runtime policy enforcement, and human approval.
* Ensure model output is validated before it reaches databases, APIs, executable systems, or customer-visible workflows.
* Improve auditability across model calls, retrieved context, tool invocations, agent decisions, and resulting actions.
* Monitor emerging AI attack techniques and translate relevant risks into practical product controls.

### **Product security**

* Review customer-facing applications and APIs for authentication, authorization, tenant-isolation, injection, and business-logic vulnerabilities.
* Secure customer-controlled payloads, file uploads, webhooks, exports, and third-party integrations.
* Reproduce security reports, determine credible impact, and distinguish exploitable vulnerabilities from theoretical findings.
* Work directly with engineers to implement production-ready fixes and regression tests.
* Help build secure, reusable patterns for input handling, authorization, secrets, data access, and external integrations.
* Perform focused code reviews, penetration tests, and architecture assessments for security-sensitive changes.

### **Platform and infrastructure**

* Build and improve the secure, reliable infrastructure behind model calls and agent workflows.
* Harden cloud permissions, service identities, secrets, storage, networking, deployment pipelines, and production access.
* Build guardrails into CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code so common security problems are caught before deployment.
* Improve model-provider routing, retries, timeouts, fallbacks, quotas, rate limits, and cost controls.
* Add observability for unusual model behavior, tool usage, data access, errors, latency, and token consumption.
* Build containment mechanisms and kill switches for unsafe or misbehaving agents.
* Support production debugging and the investigation of application, infrastructure, and AI-security incidents.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

* 2–3 years of hands-on experience across AI engineering, backend/platform engineering, application security, infrastructure security, DevSecOps, or a related engineering role.
* Experience building, operating, or securing production AI systems using LLM APIs, agents, tool calling, RAG, model gateways, or similar technologies.
* Strong programming ability in Python, TypeScript, Go, or another relevant language.
* Understanding of common web and API security risks, including authentication, authorization, injection, tenant isolation, secrets, and unsafe data handling.
* Practical experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, containers, monitoring, or infrastructure-as-code.
* Ability to investigate a suspected vulnerability, reproduce it, assess its real-world impact, and contribute an effective fix.
* Ability to reason about trust boundaries between users, models, customer data, application code, tools, and third-party services.
* Comfort debugging systems through source code, logs, traces, metrics, and database queries.
* Strong written communication and the ability to explain security risks clearly without unnecessary alarm.
* A builder’s mindset: you enjoy implementing durable controls, not only identifying problems.

We care more about strong fundamentals, practical work, and learning velocity than matching every item in the description.

**Good to have**
----------------

* Hands-on experience with AI red teaming or adversarial model testing.
* Familiarity with prompt injection, insecure output handling, tool-use vulnerabilities, agent sandboxing, or context leakage.
* Experience securing multi-tenant B2B SaaS products.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About BabyBillion**

BabyBillion is a safe, smart, and engaging learning platform for children aged 2-8. We bring together videos, games, and interactive learning in an ad-free, parent-friendly app. We're looking for a Product Manager to own the user journey, from a parent discovering the app and starting a trial to their child building a regular learning habit. You'll work closely with the leadership, engineering, design, content, and growth teams to turn user insights into measurable product improvements.

**What you'll own**

**Onboarding and conversion:**
Simplify onboarding, communicate the app's value, and improve install-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion.

**Retention and subscriptions**
: Improve the subscription experience, payment journeys, renewals, and monthly paid-user retention.

**Content discovery**
: Help children find relevant videos, categories, and playlists through better homepage layouts, recommendations, search, and navigation.

**Meaningful engagement:**
Build age-appropriate games, interactive experiences, and gamification that encourage learning and repeat usage.

**Product roadmap**
: Identify the highest-impact problems, prioritise them, and own execution from discovery to launch and post-launch measurement.

**What you'll do**

• Speak with parents and study user behaviour to understand needs, friction, and reasons for dropping off.

• Analyse funnels, cohorts, content performance, and engagement data to identify opportunities. • Write clear PRDs, user flows, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.

• Work closely with designers and engineers to ship improvements, test releases, and resolve product issues.

• Run experiments and evaluate whether changes improve conversion, retention, and learning engagement.

• Partner with the content team to improve discovery and understand why strong content may receive limited exposure.

• Collaborate with growth on acquisition-to-payment journeys, attribution, and user quality.

• Keep child safety, age appropriateness, and parent trust central to product decisions.

**Tech team collaboration and delivery**

• Own the development cycle with the tech team, from requirements and design handoff through estimation, development, QA, release, and post-launch review.

• Manage Scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Track action items and follow through on improvements.

• Maintain a prioritised backlog with clear user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a shared definition of done.

• Agree sprint goals, scope, timelines, and capacity with engineering. Balance new features, bugs, technical debt, and maintenance with the tech lead.

• Track sprint progress, surface blockers early, coordinate dependencies, and communicate delivery risks and scope changes to stakeholders.

• Coordinate QA and user acceptance testing, prioritise defects, and confirm release readiness against agreed acceptance criteria.

• Plan releases with engineering, design, content, and growth; monitor issues after launch and coordinate fixes and product improvements.

**What we're looking for**

• 1-5 years of experience in product management.

• Previous experience working on consumer apps, particularly in subscriptions, edtech, content, or gaming, is good to have.

• Strong understanding of conversion funnels, cohort analysis, retention, and experimentation.

• Comfort using product analytics tools and dashboards to identify problems and measure outcomes.

• Strong product judgement and the ability to simplify experiences for both parents and children.

• Hands-on experience working with engineering teams and managing Agile/Scrum delivery, sprint boards, and release cycles.

• Clear communication, structured thinking, and hands-on execution.

• Ownership of outcomes, with the ability to prioritise and move quickly in a startup.

**How success will be measured**

• Higher install-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion.

• Better monthly paid-user retention and renewal rates.

• Increased daily active usage among paid users.

• Improved content discovery and meaningful time spent.

• Predictable sprint delivery, fewer unresolved blockers, and stable releases with measurable impact after launch.

**Why join us?**

You'll own core product decisions, work directly with leadership, and help shape how young children learn while building a consumer subscription business.

jobs.title: Product Owner III

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

**Role Overview:**
  

PDI Technologies is looking for a Product Owner to help manage multiple simultaneous projects and issues of varying size, end to end, within our Loyalty engine ecosystem. The Product Owner (PO) is a critical member of an Agile development team that drives the team to deliver high-quality, high-value features and functions in service of our Loyalty business.

  

As a PO, you will help shape product features and requirements while working closely with Agile engineering teams, Product Managers, customers, and business stakeholders to build high-quality products for our target markets. Prior experience in Product Management, Product Owner, or Business Analyst roles — ideally with exposure to loyalty, rewards, or CRM (Customer Relationship Management) platforms — is highly desired.

  

This role is expected to use AI tools and processes as a core part of how work gets done — accelerating requirements-gathering, documentation, and story breakdown so the team can move faster without sacrificing quality.

  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
* **Stay aligned with and contribute to**
  the Loyalty product vision, roadmap, and priorities
  
* Work closely with Support to understand and prioritize customer-reported issues within the Loyalty ecosystem
  
* Work closely with system users (customers, partners, consulting) to understand business needs and translate them into actionable user stories
  
* Apply technical astuteness, attention to detail, and proactivity to drive closure and optimize development team throughput
  
* Use AI-assisted tools and workflows to speed up requirements analysis, documentation, and backlog preparation
  
* Serve as a product evangelist, particularly with Product Managers and Business teams, helping them understand platform best practices
  
* Develop documentation for new Loyalty features, including UI mockups, process flows, and data sequence diagrams
  
* Attend sprint planning meetings and work with the team to define sprint goals
  
* Guide Agile teams in breaking down user stories and defining acceptance criteria
  
* Ensure the product backlog is prioritized and properly balanced between new product work and maintenance
  
* Collaborate with engineering during sprints to review output and answer questions about desired functionality and outcomes
  
* Ensure the team has an appropriately groomed backlog ready for sprint planning; monitor ready stories vs. velocity
  
* Conduct backlog refinement meetings, sprint reviews, and product demos
  
* Manage the product backlog in ALM tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  
* Author and publish product release notes and customer notifications
  
* Own release planning for Loyalty initiatives
  
  

  
**Qualifications:**
  

  
* Ability to connect technical system behavior (rules engines, transaction/redemption flows, integrations) with business goals for the Loyalty program
